plainLanguageSections.title: What Hearthline supports
plainLanguageSections.body: Hearthline supports consensual, unpaid adult social connection, friendship, dating, romance, affection, adult conversation, and voluntary adult encounters.

plainLanguageSections.title: Arizona commercial-sex boundary
plainLanguageSections.body: Arizona law prohibits sexual conduct under a fee arrangement involving money or other valuable consideration. Hearthline does not support prices, rates, payment links, deposits, tips, payments, gifts conditioned on intimacy, debt relief, housing, lodging, transportation, work, goods, or services exchanged for sexual activity.

plainLanguageSections.title: Consent remains current
plainLanguageSections.body: A profile, message, match, shared preference, meeting plan, charter, app state, or prior encounter is not consent to any future real-world activity. Each person can pause, change their mind, decline, or leave at any time.

plainLanguageSections.title: Practical plans stay separate
plainLanguageSections.body: Adults may discuss public venues, accessibility, transit, independent arrival, and low-cost activities. Hearthline does not connect rides, hosting, lodging, money, gifts, work, debt relief, or other valuable consideration to sexual access or intimacy.

plainLanguageSections.title: What this page does not do
plainLanguageSections.body: This page does not give legal advice, decide whether a particular situation is lawful, assess anyone's intent, or create a record that you read or agreed to these statements.
